scope: Synthetic local three-journal rollback boundary; no live keys, RPC, transaction or Mainnet activation

steps: Copy all three published empty role-labelled journal files.
Run one conversion through the actual fixture controller and role services until an unknown send has persisted both signatures and one broadcast attempt.
Restore all three earlier valid journal files while retaining the same program, policy and journal references.
Call prepareTokenConversionRuntime for the controller in recovery-only mode and require rejection before authentication.
probe.expected: Conversion journal reference unavailable or incompatible; no authentication or custody load
probe.observed: prepareTokenConversionRuntime resolved; Node test exit 1 with Missing expected rejection at the new assertion
probe.baseline: The same source rejects a missing, corrupt, wrong-context or single-role-rollback journal; coherent rollback removes all cross-journal evidence together.

releaseDecision: Open blocker: an intact older set cannot prove that no later signed attempt existed.
requiredBoundary: Use a separately durable and independently restored monotonic attempt anchor that records each role's signed attempt before its signature leaves the signer and records the controller wire before broadcast.
Quiesce all three services for a consistent backup, restore all role journals plus the external anchor together, then reconcile unknown attempts before fresh signing.
Reject missing, stale, corrupt or contradictory anchor evidence before authentication or custody; do not treat a caller-supplied digest or three mutually consistent files as independent proof.
missingOperationalInput: config/mainnet-deployment-plan.json has freshInfrastructure.backupReference null; no approved external monotonic journal anchor or production three-store restore has been supplied.
changes: Evidence only. No runtime code, signer policy, contract binary or live service changed.
